options iteration=100 duration=90;

noelle char lvl=90/90 cons=6 talent=9,9,9;
noelle add weapon="redhornstonethresher" lvl=90/90 refine=1;
noelle add set="huskofopulentdreams" count=4;

noelle add stats def%=0.9 cd=0.4;

target lvl=90 resist=0.1 pos=0,1;

active noelle;
while 1 {
    if .noelle.burst.ready { noelle burst; }
    if .noelle.skill.ready { noelle skill; }
    if .noelle.attack.ready { noelle attack:4; }
}
